reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is simplified to Math.min and a single subtraction.

placement.why: The worst-case rule stays in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, the function every consumer already calls.

scope.why: Only the two worst-case expressions and their tests change.

maintainability.why: The new rule ('lowest value allowed') is expressed directly and more simply than before.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No caller is changed; all go through getScheduledAmount.
